title: Yellow Spicy Middle Eastern Turkey Labneh Bowl
description: A nutty and bouncy Middle Eastern dish featuring turkey, confit tomato, and labneh, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is low in sodium and rich in flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, sumac, paprika, cumin, and salt-free seasoning blend, and mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Form the turkey mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, drizzle with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and bake for 18 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the turkey is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the confit tomatoes to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
To assemble the bowls, divide the labneh cheese among four bowls, then top with a turkey patty, some confit tomatoes, chopped parsley, and chopped mint.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the top of each bowl and serve immediately.
